summary.text: Joseph Montoya is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Javier Mabrey.
His campaign website describes him as a Denver-based paralegal and musician who performs as Ghost Elvis.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Montoya's campaign website describes him as a paralegal, musician, father, mentor and Christian leader.
The site says his platform emphasizes public safety and law enforcement, and that he is running to bring Republican values to the state level.
